shots.scene: 欣欣站在推车上一只绿色气瓶旁，手拿放大镜，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a green gas cylinder strapped to a cylinder cart, holding a magnifying glass, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课教你读懂气瓶上的标记。
overlay: 压缩气瓶：读懂气瓶标记

shots.scene: 阿杰盯着瓶肩密密麻麻的钢印发愣
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stares at rows of stamped marks on a cylinder shoulder, looking puzzled.
shots.narration: 阿杰看着满瓶的钢印，一头雾水。

shots.scene: 小研拿着放大镜走过来
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student walks over holding a magnifying glass and smiles.
shots.narration: 小研说：一行一行读，其实不难。

shots.section_title: 会读标记是用气基本功
shots.scene: 小研用手指着瓶肩钢印，欣欣在旁点头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student traces the stamped marks on the cylinder shoulder with a gloved finger while the panda mascot nods.
shots.narration: 用气瓶做研究，要会找检验日期。
overlay: 会读标记是用气基本功

shots.section_title: 会读标记是用气基本功
shots.scene: 钢印特写旁出现放大镜和打勾图标
shots.prompt_en: A close-up of stamped marks on a cylinder shoulder with a magnifying glass icon and a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 看懂其他标记，也是基本功。

shots.scene: 瓶肩钢印特写，旁边浮现五个空白小卡片
shots.prompt_en: A close-up of stamped marks on a cylinder shoulder with five small blank cards floating beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 钢印标明气瓶的各项规格：

shots.scene: 钢印旁的工厂、身份证、日历三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons beside stamped marks: a factory, an ID card and a calendar. No people.
shots.narration: 怎么造的、编号、何时造、谁的、何时检。

shots.section_title: 瓶颈处的产权或制造单位
shots.scene: 瓶颈圈分段标题：瓶颈圈图标
shots.prompt_en: A clean title card showing only an icon of a cylinder neck ring. No people.
shots.narration: 先看瓶颈圈。
overlay: 瓶颈处的产权或制造单位

shots.section_title: 瓶颈处的产权或制造单位
shots.scene: 红褐色气瓶瓶颈圈上的刻字，手指示意（刻字模糊不可读）
shots.prompt_en: A gloved finger points at blurred engraved letters on the neck ring of a reddish brown gas cylinder. No people.
shots.narration: 上面刻着现所有者或制造商的名字。

shots.scene: 标签分段标题后，绿色气瓶上的空白标签，带不燃气体菱形标志
shots.prompt_en: A green gas cylinder with a blank product label showing only a green non-flammable gas diamond label. No people.
shots.narration: 每只气瓶都要有清楚的标签。

shots.scene: 标签图标旁浮现气体名、危害两张卡片
shots.prompt_en: A blank label icon with two blank cards floating beside it: one with a gas cylinder icon, one with a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 写明装的是什么，比如氮气，不燃。

shots.scene: 一排各种颜色的气瓶，问号在中间
shots.prompt_en: A row of gas cylinders of many different colors with a question mark above them. No people.
shots.narration: 绝不能靠颜色判断里面是什么气。

shots.section_title: 读标签，查安全技术说明书
shots.scene: 小研手扶气瓶查看标签，再翻阅空白说明书
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds a cylinder, reads its label, then flips through a blank safety data sheet booklet.
shots.narration: 一定要读标签和安全技术说明书。
overlay: 读标签，查安全技术说明书

shots.section_title: 读标签，查安全技术说明书
shots.scene: 说明书旁的危害、性质、安全三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons beside a blank document: a warning triangle, a molecule and a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 了解内容物、危害、性质和安全信息。

shots.scene: 小研扶着推车上的气瓶，旁边几只不同颜色的同种气瓶
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds a cylinder on a cart, next to several cylinders of the same gas painted in different colors.
shots.narration: 不同制造商、经销商，配色各不相同。

shots.scene: 没有标签的灰色气瓶插图被大红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An illustration of a grey gas cylinder with no label at all, crossed out with a big red X. No people.
shots.narration: 标签缺失的气瓶，不能使用。

shots.scene: 小研打电话联系经销商
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student phones the gas distributor while standing beside an unlabeled cylinder.
shots.narration: 立即联系经销商。

shots.section_title: 气瓶一般租用，由供方送检
shots.scene: 戴护目镜的小研推着气瓶推车走过走廊，进入实验室
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wearing safety goggles pushes a cylinder cart along a corridor and into a lab.
shots.narration: 研究人员一般不自己买气瓶。
overlay: 气瓶一般租用，由供方送检

shots.section_title: 气瓶一般租用，由供方送检
shots.scene: 气瓶旁的水压试验图标和钱袋图标
shots.prompt_en: A cylinder icon next to a water pressure testing tank icon and a money bag icon. No people.
shots.narration: 自有气瓶要自己做水压试验，很贵。

shots.section_title: 气瓶一般租用，由供方送检
shots.scene: 学校化学品库图标，箭头把气瓶送往实验室
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a campus chemical store building with an arrow sending a cylinder to a lab icon. No people.
shots.narration: 可以向学校化学品库租用。

shots.section_title: 气瓶一般租用，由供方送检
shots.scene: 日历和硬币图标，旁边气体图标
shots.prompt_en: A calendar icon with a coin icon, plus a gas cloud icon with another coin. No people.
shots.narration: 每月约10美元，气体另外付费。

shots.scene: 日期标记分段标题后，手扶推车上的气瓶
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand rests on a cylinder strapped to a cart. No people.
shots.narration: 气瓶必须定期检验，

shots.scene: 运输、充装、使用三个图标上方出现绿色盾牌
shots.prompt_en: Three icons, a delivery truck, a filling station and a lab bench, each with a green shield above it. No people.
shots.narration: 保护运输、充装和使用的人。

shots.scene: 瓶肩日期钢印特写，手指指向一个五角星
shots.prompt_en: A gloved finger points at a small five-pointed star stamped next to a date on a cylinder shoulder. No people.
shots.narration: 标记会告诉你多久检一次。

shots.scene: 五角星图标等于十年日历
shots.prompt_en: A five-pointed star icon equals a calendar icon showing ten years. No people.
shots.narration: 比如五角星：下次检验在10年后。

shots.scene: 气瓶被推回经销商仓库的示意
shots.prompt_en: A cylinder on a cart rolls back toward a distributor warehouse icon and a factory icon. No people.
shots.narration: 按瓶上日期，送回经销商或制造商。

shots.section_title: 只有一个日期：制造和首检
shots.scene: 钢印中最上方的单一日期被黄圈标出
shots.prompt_en: A gloved finger points at the single top date line on a cylinder shoulder, circled in yellow. No people.
shots.narration: 只有一个日期，就是制造兼首检日期。
overlay: 只有一个日期：制造和首检

shots.section_title: 只有一个日期：制造和首检
shots.scene: 日历图标显示1955年3月
shots.prompt_en: A calendar icon with a vintage factory icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 这只气瓶，1955年3月出厂首检。

shots.section_title: 检验周期因瓶因气而异
shots.scene: 日历图标上标出5年周期
shots.prompt_en: A calendar icon with a five-year cycle arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 一般每5年检验一次。
overlay: 检验周期因瓶因气而异

shots.section_title: 检验周期因瓶因气而异
shots.scene: 钢瓶、铝瓶和不同气体图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a steel cylinder, an aluminum cylinder and several different gas icons. No people.
shots.narration: 但会因材质和所装气体而不同。

shots.scene: 手指指向其下多行日期
shots.prompt_en: A gloved finger moves down several stamped date lines below the first one. No people.
shots.narration: 其余日期，都是复检日期。

shots.scene: 复检标记示意：五个空白格依次排开
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of a retest mark with five blank boxes in a row: a calendar, a building, a calendar, a plus sign and a star. No people.
shots.narration: 格式：月、检验机构、年、加号、星号。

shots.section_title: 找到最近一次，算出下一次
shots.scene: 加号图标旁气瓶多装一格的示意
shots.prompt_en: A plus sign icon next to a cylinder diagram with a small extra fill segment on top. No people.
shots.narration: 加号表示这只气瓶可以超装10%。
overlay: 找到最近一次，算出下一次

shots.section_title: 找到最近一次，算出下一次
shots.scene: 手指逐行读日期，七行依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: A gloved finger reads down the date lines while seven retest lines light up one after another. No people.
shots.narration: 这只气瓶一共做过七次复检。

shots.section_title: 找到最近一次，算出下一次
shots.scene: 手指停在银色检验贴上
shots.prompt_en: The gloved finger stops on a silver inspection sticker below the stamped marks. No people.
shots.narration: 最近一次是2021年11月。

shots.section_title: 找到最近一次，算出下一次
shots.scene: 日历从2021翻到2026，旁边没有星号
shots.prompt_en: A calendar icon flips forward five years with a crossed-out star icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 没有星号，2026年就要复检。

shots.section_title: 制造依据的标准和监管
shots.scene: 其他标记分段标题后，瓶肩另一侧的钢印
shots.prompt_en: Another side of the cylinder shoulder with a stamped specification code and serial number. No people.
shots.narration: 再看其他钢印。
overlay: 制造依据的标准和监管

shots.section_title: 制造依据的标准和监管
shots.scene: 钢印特写，开头三个字母被黄圈标出
shots.prompt_en: A close-up of a stamped code with its first three letters circled in yellow, next to a government building icon. No people.
shots.narration: DOT开头，表示美国运输部规格。

shots.section_title: 制造依据的标准和监管
shots.scene: 老式气瓶和带枫叶图标的气瓶并排
shots.prompt_en: An old cylinder icon and a cylinder icon with a maple leaf beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 老瓶可能是ICC，加拿大的是CTC。

shots.section_title: 制造依据的标准和监管
shots.scene: 规格代号旁出现监管机构图标
shots.prompt_en: A stamped code next to an official building icon with a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 表明气瓶按哪个机构的规定制造。

shots.scene: 手指指认规格号后面的材质代号
shots.prompt_en: A gloved finger points at the material code following the specification code. No people.
shots.narration: 后面是材质代号。

shots.scene: 钢瓶和铝瓶两个剖面图标
shots.prompt_en: Two cutaway icons: a steel cylinder and an aluminum cylinder. No people.
shots.narration: 3AA、3A是钢瓶，3AL是铝瓶。

shots.scene: 压力表图标，旁边气瓶
shots.prompt_en: A pressure gauge icon with a blank dial next to a cylinder icon. No people.
shots.narration: 再后面是工作压力，比如2260 psi。

shots.scene: 钢印中一串编号被黄圈标出，旁边身份证图标
shots.prompt_en: A stamped serial number on a cylinder shoulder circled in yellow, next to an ID card icon. No people.
shots.narration: 然后是气瓶的序列号。

shots.scene: 瓶肩上的空白条码贴纸和产品贴纸
shots.prompt_en: A blank barcode sticker and a blank product sticker on a cylinder shoulder. No people.
shots.narration: 还可能有经销商的条码贴纸，

shots.scene: 条码贴纸旁浮现批号卡片
shots.prompt_en: A blank barcode sticker with a small blank lot number card floating beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 标着批号等信息。

shots.section_title: 查本校手册，有疑问就问
shots.scene: 王老师递给阿杰一本空白的气瓶安全手册
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator hands the young male student a blank gas cylinder safety handbook.
shots.narration: 更多内容查气瓶安全指南，不懂就问。
overlay: 查本校手册，有疑问就问

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现瓶颈圈、标签图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a neck ring and a blank label.
shots.narration: 瓶颈看所有者，标签看气体和危害。

shots.scene: 颜色打叉、无标签打叉两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a colored cylinder with a red X and an unlabeled cylinder with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不凭颜色认气体，没标签不用。

shots.scene: 日期钢印、加号、星号三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: stamped date lines, a plus sign and a star. No people.
shots.narration: 读懂日期钢印，按时送回检验。

shots.scene: 欣欣拿着放大镜在气瓶旁挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a magnifying glass beside a strapped gas cylinder and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 看懂标记再用气，下次见！
